properties.summary: Compaction recovery rides the hosts' injectable events, not the compaction hooks: on Claude Code 2.1.272 PreCompact/PostCompact are observe-only and re-injection uses SessionStart with the compact source (plus UserPromptSubmit); on Codex 0.154.0 PreCompact/PostCompact/SubagentStop/Stop are observe-only and re-injection uses SessionStart(resume)/UserPromptSubmit; capture-before-loss uses the observe-only pre-compaction event on both
